question: True or false: in top-flight football, teams usually keep more of the ball while winning than while losing?
answer: False. Teams that go ahead tend to sit deeper and let the opponent have it, while teams behind push forward with the ball. Lago-Peñas and Dellal found Spanish sides had more possession when losing and less when winning. Raw possession partly records the scoreline rather than causing it.
move: Before reading a statistic as a cause, ask whether the result caused it.
ask: Which number I watch might be a result of how things are going, rather than the cause?
trap: Assuming more possession is what makes a team the one ahead.
reference: Lago-Peñas & Dellal, Ball possession strategies in elite soccer according to the evolution of the match-score: the influence of situational variables, Journal of Human Kinetics, 2010
